editions.text: The station recorded 124 feeder visits, compared to the recent weekly average of 230. The species count dipped to 18 from the mean of 20. Tufted Titmice were the most frequent visitors, seen 64 times, with Carolina Chickadees and Northern Cardinals following at 14 and 11 visits respectively. American Crows, Carolina Wrens, and Northern Cardinals provided the bulk of vocal detections. The day concluded with a Tufted Titmouse visiting 21 minutes before sunset, following its arrival 12 minutes before sunrise.
